output_text:
import os
import openai

def save_audio(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = openai.OpenAI(api_key=config.get("api_key", os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")))
    result = client.audio.speech.create(model=config.get("model", "tts-1"), voice=config.get("voice", "alloy"), input=payload)
    return result
